data: What is the highest phoneme error rate recorded in 'Softmax Adaptation'?

The question asks for the highest phoneme error rate recorded in 'Softmax Adaptation'. From the caption, we know that the left graph represents 'Softmax Adaptation'. The y-axis shows the Phoneme Error Rate (PER), and the x-axis shows the Percentage amount of Training data. 

Looking at the left graph, we can see four lines representing different models for both Kurmanji and Swahili. The highest point on any line corresponds to the highest phoneme error rate. By visually inspecting the graph, the highest phoneme error rate appears to be around 60% for the Kurmanji model (blue line). This is also the highest point among all the lines in the graph. Therefore, the highest phoneme error rate recorded in 'Softmax Adaptation' is approximately 60%.
